note: Mission 1 (First Watch) content: the owner's Ableton exports in ToAddTry1/ (three kick patterns with one snare pattern, two bass lines with five and four recordings, three audio-only backing loops). Run: python tools/content/import_ableton.py content/imports/first_watch.json, then python tools/content/build.py level_01. Names are provisional: rename in content/sounds.json and the clip.json files. Levels: drums and bass peak at -4 dBFS, bass recordings RMS-matched to -17 dBFS where that peak allows, backing at -3 dBFS, then a global trim so the loudest combination of options stays below about -3 dBFS.

clips.name: Half-Time
clips.note: Kick1 with Snare1: one kick per bar alternating beat 1 and beat 2, a pickup in bar 7; snare on beat 3 of every bar.

clips.name: Double Step
clips.note: Kick2 with Snare1: kicks on beats 1 and 2 of the odd bars, beat 2 of the even bars; snare on beat 3.

clips.name: Rolling
clips.note: Kick3 with Snare1: kicks on beats 1, 2 and 4 of the odd bars, beat 2 of the even bars, a turnaround in bars 7-8; snare on beat 3.

clips.name: Sub Line
clips.note: Bass1: long sustained notes (whole bars, halves and quarters), 15 notes over eight bars. Every note is a hold.

clips.name: Reese Line
clips.note: Bass2: the same harmony with shorter, syncopated notes, 23 notes over eight bars. Every note is a hold (the shortest are three sixteenths).

clips.name: Driving Hats
clips.note: Other1: a bright top loop (energy above 4 kHz) on the beats with pickups; the export's silent bars 9-14 are dropped.

clips.name: Busy Hats
clips.note: Other2: the busiest top loop, sixteenth-note offbeats.

clips.name: Offbeat Hats
clips.note: Other3: a top loop on the eighth-note offbeats.
